parameters.content:
## 🚀 Setup Instructions
1. Replace **YOUR_APIFY_API_TOKEN** in the Apify node with your free token from https://console.apify.com/account/integrations
2. Customize search keywords in the **Fetch Latest ArXiv Papers** node if desired.
3. Connect the output of **Format Research Digest** to Slack, Discord, Notion, or your Vector DB (Qdrant/Pinecone).
